slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: One tender spot on a bone

caption:
Toto dusted off the runners after months away. Lungs felt fine, legs felt like lead the next day. Fitness often comes back faster than tendons and bones adapt.

Hybi's return plan: jog 1 minute, walk 2, for 20–30 minutes, running every second day at first. Add time before pace, and every 3–4 weeks hold steady so the body can catch up.

Use the next-morning test. Mild soreness that settles overnight is usually fine; pain that's worse the next day means dropping back a step. Add calf raises, split squats and bridges twice a week.

One tender spot on a bone, pain that's worse each run, swelling or night pain are worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
